correctness.rationale: For P=(1/10)[[8,1,1],[3,3,4],[1,7,2]] and pi=(14/27,5/18,11/54), independently recomputed pi P=pi, pi_2 P_21=1/12 and pi_2 P_23=1/9. For length-two holes the killed transition matrix B_ij=P with only edge ij zeroed, and survival after n observations is pi B_ij^n 1. Both B matrices remain primitive substochastic. Exact characteristic polynomial of B21 is (10z-7)(20z^2-12z-5)/200, Perron root (3+sqrt(34))/10<9/10. The B23 polynomial z^3-(13/10)z^2+(21/50)z-3/50 changes sign from -3/500 at 9/10 to +3/50 at 1, hence its Perron root exceeds 9/10. As -log decreases, escape(21)>escape(23). The two prime length-two cylinders on a two-symbol stationary chain (12,21) have equal masses by stationarity, proving the restricted alphabet minimum. Finite n checks are not the spectral-limit proof.
